name: Disneyland River Belle Terrace Grilled Pork Chop or Smoked Brisket & Mashed Potatoes
whyItWorks: Sit-down Southern comfort food overlooking the Rivers of America; tender smoked brisket or grilled pork chop with mashed potatoes and soft rolls avoids fryer oil when ordered with BBQ sauce on the side.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Order the Pork Chop, Brisket, or Sustainable Fish with mashed potatoes and ask for all sauces/gravies on the side.
watchOuts: Skip baked beans, raw slaw, and spicy Nashville hot chicken dishes
